views.title: Reorder, hide, and compact the iOS text selection menu

views.markdown:
Put the text actions you use within easy reach. SimpleRightMenu lets you organize the native iOS text selection menu, reduce clutter, choose a compact look, and add search and scratchpad tools.

## What you can do

- Your menu, your order: Drag and drop available native actions such as Copy, Translate, Find Selection, AutoFill and Look Up into your preferred order.
- Less clutter: Hide actions you do not use. New Quick Note is hidden by default.
- Three display styles: Choose Text, Icon + Text, or compact Icon Only. Paste and Search has a distinct clipboard-and-magnifier icon so you can tell it apart from Paste.
- Quick Text Box (Menu & Control Center): Open an independent scratchpad from the edit menu or from the Control Center tile (requires CCSupport) to paste, type, or edit text. Closing the box copies the entire draft to your clipboard, and when opened from Control Center, closing the box also dismisses Control Center automatically. Includes an optional setting to display Quick Text Box as an icon only while keeping text labels on the rest of the menu.
- Search with Google AI: On supported iOS 16+ edit menus, select text and tap Search with AI. By default, a small editable popup opens with your selection and a prepared prompt that asks Google AI Mode to search, explain, or follow your request using current information and reliable sources. You can also turn on Send Immediately in Settings to skip the popup and open Google AI Mode right away, turn prompt attachment off, or save your own custom prompt.
- Search Google / Open Link: Search the web for selected text, or open a selected web address directly, including links with non-English Unicode characters.
- Google Translate: Open the selected text in Google Translate, using your device language as the target language.
- Always Show Select All: Keep Select All available when part of the text is selected in supported, nonsecure text fields.
- In-Settings Language Switcher (Auto / English / Vietnamese): Switch the tweak and Settings interface between Auto, English, and Vietnamese at any time. When using the default AI prompt, the prompt language follows this setting automatically. Changes apply immediately without a respring.

Available actions depend on the current app, selection and field type. Requires iOS 15 or later. Rootless and RootHide packages are available.

- Add Search with Google AI on supported iOS 16+ edit menus: open an editable popup with your selection and a default English/Vietnamese prompt, or turn on Send Immediately to open Google AI Mode directly. Includes an Attach Prompt toggle and a single customizable prompt in Settings.
- Add Quick Text Box to the edit menu and as a Control Center module (CCSupport): open a blank scratchpad to paste, type, or edit text, copy the draft on close, and automatically dismiss Control Center when closing the box.
- Add an in-Settings Language selector (Auto / English / Tiếng Việt) that switches the interface, menu labels, and default AI prompt language on the fly, plus an independent Icon Only toggle for Quick Text Box.
- Sanitize unpaired UTF-16 surrogates, attachment characters, and non-ASCII URLs with strict RFC 3986 encoding across Google Search, Open Link, Google Translate, and AI Search, and remove experimental auto-show/vertical menu hooks.

- Remove automatic menu-show and experimental vertical-menu behavior; preserve native horizontal menus.
- Add editable Search with AI on supported iOS 16+ edit menus with full-query Google AI Mode and browser/Safari routing instead of ordinary universal-link routing.
- Remove forced English/Vietnamese output language from the AI prompt.
- Preserve native correction suggestions and validate Select All for supported nonsecure text inputs; retrieve WebKit selection asynchronously without stale clipboard fallback.
- Fix MobileSafari crash on iOS 18 RootHide caused by WebKit synchronous selection getters (`EXC_BREAKPOINT`).
- Fix **Auto-Show Menu on Selection** so the menu pops up immediately after dragging selection handles or using Spacebar trackpad without needing an extra tap.
- Automatically dismiss the edit menu when selected text is deleted/cleared (fixes lone Select All button staying on empty text fields).
- Add **Auto-Show Menu on Selection** toggle in Settings.

- Initial public release (Rootless & RootHide)
- Drag-and-drop reordering and show/hide toggles for all iOS text selection menu items
- Text, Icon + Text, and compact Icon Only display styles (with composite dual icon for Paste and Search)
- Extra actions: Search Google / Open Link, Google Translate, and Always Show Select All
- English and Vietnamese localization
